verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an in-builder code editor where a developer can open and directly edit the generated source. 'Visual controls and live preview' is a related but different feature, and GitHub sync or push edits code outside the builder, so neither counts. The axis applies to an AI app builder, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder
